announcements.headline: EQS-News: TRATON GROUP’s International Motors receives U.S. content approval from U.S. Department of Commerce
announcements.insight: Regulatory approval supports ongoing operations following recent strong sales growth. Shareholders should monitor subsequent quarterly results for continued momentum.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: TRATON GROUP increases unit sales, sales revenue, and adjusted operating result in the first nine months of 2026
announcements.insight: Sales revenue and adjusted operating result rise following Q2 profit beats and strong Q3 volume growth. This confirms sustained operational improvement for shareholders.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: TRATON GROUP increases third quarter 2026 unit sales by 10% to 78,900 vehicles driven by strong US business
announcements.insight: Traton SE raises Q3 unit sales by 10% to 78,900 vehicles. This follows a 4% increase in Q2 and improved profitability announced in July.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: TRATON GROUP improves profitability and increases incoming orders by 30% in the first half of 2026
announcements.insight: Profitability improves alongside a 30% surge in incoming orders, following Q2 unit sales growth and operating results that already exceeded market expectations.

announcements.headline: EQS-Adhoc: TRATON SE: Preliminary operating result for Q2 2026 exceeds market expectations
announcements.insight: Operating results exceeding expectations follow a 4% unit sales increase in Q2. This suggests improved operational performance for shareholders.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: TRATON GROUP increases unit sales by 4% to 82,900 vehicles in the second quarter of 2026
announcements.insight: Unit sales increased by 4% to 82,900 vehicles in Q2 2026. This follows the AGM approval of board actions in June.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: TRATON Annual General Meeting approves Executive and Supervisory Boards' actions and resolves on a dividend of €0.93 per share for 2025
announcements.insight: The Annual General Meeting approved a dividend of €0.93 per share for 2025, providing direct income to shareholders.
